entities.name: Přemyslid Duchy & Kingdom of Bohemia
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Přemyslid dynasty united Bohemia: St. Wenceslas (patron saint, murdered 935), the elevation to a kingdom (1198/1212 Golden Bull of Sicily), and Přemysl Ottokar II's brief control of territories from the Baltic to the Adriatic.
